load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter into a diffusers model from a pretrained model path or state dict
save_lora_adapter: save a LoRA adapter's parameters to a directory in safetensors or pickle format
set_adapters: set active adapters and their weights for multi-adapter inference on a diffusion model
fuse_lora: fuse LoRA layers into the base model weights for faster inference with a given scale
enable_lora_hotswap: enable hotswapping of LoRA adapters to avoid recompilation when switching adapters
